tag: MJM's entropy becomes a typed constant again
why: THE CLASS THIS ITEM EXISTS FOR. A constant satisfies every assertion about a field's presence, type and range; only a comparison across two different signals separates a measurement from a literal. The guard compares a low-variety and a high-variety signal for exactly this reason.

tag: the negative zero returns, so a measured zero reads as a broken one
why: A single-symbol payload computes -0.0. A figure served as negative zero reads like a measurement that went wrong rather than one that came out at zero.

tag: the entropy refusal narrows to TypeError and ValueError
old: except Exception:                      # noqa: BLE001 — see below; this is on a public route
why: `default=str` makes nearly anything serialisable, so the reachable failure is not a type error: an object whose own __str__ raises propagates whatever that raises. This method is reached from /api/v1/cognitive/cascade, so that would be a 500 on a hostile input.

tag: muaina claims a perfect compliance again
why: 1.0 was never a measurement that came out high; it was the absence of a compliance assessment written as its best possible outcome, served raw by api/cognitive.py.

tag: a bare digest is called a Merkle proof again
why: A digest of one object proves no inclusion: no tree, no sibling path, no root. Nothing could be checked with it and no second party could use it. SELECTOR WIDENED W538: renaming this key broke test_w533, which asserted the OLD name was present while the new guard asserted it was absent. Both readers live in one file, so a blind selecting only this round's test would have driven half the class.

tag: the unread MJM learner is stored again, implying it is consulted
why: A parameter that is always None and never read is not an extension point; storing it states that an extension exists. Consulting the MJM tier would also import the figures FU-328 fixed.

tag: the LEARN stage can no longer learn even with a recorded outcome
why: FU-341 asked whether the 0.0ms LEARN stage is a declined update or an unreached branch. With this disabled it becomes genuinely unreachable, and the guard must notice — otherwise the evidence closing FU-341 proves nothing.

tag: the stale justification returns to avatars/api.py
old: stage: since W533 it runs all six, driven from the heartbeat, with each stage's
new: stage: it fails on its very first execution stage, with each stage's
why: The docstring's stated reason for not routing through the orchestrator was true when written and false since W533. A stale justification is read by the next round as the reason, and either repeated or disproved at the cost of a measurement.

tag: the stale 'returns literals' disclosure comes back to vsb.py
old: since W538 its own figures are measured or declared NOT ASSESSED"
why: api/vsb.py disclosed MJM's literals correctly and named the values. Fixing the producer made that disclosure false, and a stale disclosure is the same defect as a missing one: the next round reads it as the state of the code.
